title: Shermans' direwolf survives a 12-gauge shotgun

tellings.quote: >> Yeah, large direwolf that actually attacked their prized cattle.

plain: In the mid 1990s, at Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah ranch known for reports of strange events, the Sherman family who lived there say a huge wolf attacked their prized cattle and then shrugged off blasts from a 12-gauge shotgun. Brandon Fugal, the ranch's current owner, tells Michels this, citing a report by Zack Van Eyk in the Utah newspaper Deseret News. Told as true, it is one of the early signs that something on the ranch did not behave like ordinary animals.
